# Coding for MBA

> A structured 108-day curriculum covering Python, Data Science, Machine Learning, Business Intelligence, and Enterprise SQL — designed for MBA professionals.

## Site Architecture

- /: Home - Landing page and curriculum overview
- /curriculum: Full curriculum list
- /phase/{1-9}: Phase overviews (e.g., /phase/1 for Python Basics)
- /lesson/{1-108}: Daily lessons (e.g., /lesson/1 for Setup)
- /exercises: Interactive coding exercises
- /concepts: Knowledge graph of technical concepts
- /solutions/{1-9}: Notebook solutions for each phase
- /stats: Content statistics
- /review: Review questions

## Key Concepts
- Python Programming
- Data Science (Pandas, NumPy)
- Machine Learning (Scikit-Learn)
- Business Intelligence
- SQL & Data Engineering
